quote_or_datapoint: Responsible Persons should seek assurance from their fire alarm and monitoring providers that their systems are suitable for operation beyond January 2027; fire alarm activations may not transmit correctly.

implied_payer: Fire alarm maintenance contractor; Facilities manager / Responsible Person

who_affected: Premises with fire or intruder alarms signalling to ARCs via PSTN/ISDN lines (UK)
